mainEntity.name: Is converting an existing garage better than building a new detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an attached garage is generally faster and more budget-friendly, but it eliminates covered vehicle parking and vehicle storage. A garage conversion capitalizes on existing exterior walls, roof framing, and foundation, though the slab must be leveled and conditioned, and wall insulation and drywall added. A detached new build preserves your vehicle parking and offers total layout freedom, but it requires new foundation work, exterior framing, and trenching utilities across the yard.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions save on framing and foundation costs but eliminate covered parking, while detached units preserve storage and maximize privacy at a higher cost.
